definitions.explanation: A flour milled from regular (non-glutinous) short-grain rice, used to make {団子|だんご}, {柏餅|かしわもち}, and other Japanese sweets that need a firm, springy texture.

examples.japanese: {上新粉|じょうしんこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I make dango with non-glutinous rice flour.

examples.japanese: {上新粉|じょうしんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{熱湯|ねっとう}→熱湯：13460_nettou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧こねる。
examples.english: Knead the rice flour with boiling water.

examples.japanese: {上新粉|じょうしんこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{蒸|む}して→蒸す：02307_musu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧つく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{滑|なめ}らか→滑らか：06068_nameraka⟧でこし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you steam and then pound non-glutinous rice flour, you get smooth, chewy dango.

notes:
Made from うるち{米|まい} (regular short-grain rice), unlike ⟦もち{米|ごめ}→もち米：10664_mochigome⟧ (glutinous rice) which produces もち{粉|こ} and ⟦{白玉粉|しらたまこ}→白玉粉：24188_shiratamako⟧. Gives a firmer, chewier texture than glutinous rice flours.

SIMILAR FLOURS:
- ⟦{白玉粉|しらたまこ}→白玉粉：24188_shiratamako⟧: shiratamako — from glutinous rice; for soft, smooth dango
- もち{粉|こ}: mochi flour — from glutinous rice; for soft mochi
- {団子粉|だんごこ}: dango flour — usually a blend of {上新粉|じょうしんこ} and ⟦{白玉粉|しらたまこ}→白玉粉：24188_shiratamako⟧
- {道明寺粉|どうみょうじこ}: coarse glutinous rice flour for sakura-mochi
